lines.en: April!
April!
Where have you been? Oh my God!
Hey, how are you?
I'm okay. I'm dying to see you.
I called, I texted you like a billion times.
Oh, I'm sorry. I was in Venezuela.
Oh, really? Wow.
Across the pond.
I know. I thought maybe I would have heard from you at least once because of what happened.
Anne kissing me. I'm so sorry about that. It was so stupid and it meant nothing.
I wouldn't worry about it. It's totally fine.
Hey, this is my boyfriend, Eduardo.
No, it's not.
Please sip our lunche. See?
That means we're going to lunch.
How do you say have a great time? Don't choke on anything.
Bye.
Budget solution number 28. Use grazing sheep to mow grass in parks.
Note. Tired sheep could become food or sweaters.
Well, I got my answer about April. She hates me. Yeah. And she got a boyfriend, I guess, from some city in Mexico. So, what do I do?
Okay. Well, when your back's against the wall and odds are stacked against you, you just, you swing the hardest, damn it. You go big or you go home.
And you don't seem like the kind of guy who goes home.
I'm not. I'm not. I don't even really have a home.
Go get her, Andy.
Okay. Okay. Thanks, Leslie.
Hello, April. Do you like the flowers?
What are you doing?
All due respect, Eduardo, you seem like a great guy. But I like April and I'm coming after her with everything I've got. So, do you want to go out with me?
No.
I thought you were going to say yes, but that's okay. Because I'll be back tomorrow to ask you again. And again. The next day. And the next day. Not Friday. I have to go visit my cousin.
But I will be back after that to ask you again.
You should do it. Follow your dream. Oh my God. Really? That's awesome. I'll see you tomorrow.
Bye.
